post.description: Signing out revokes the session for good; the account keeps its matches.

schema.title: Response Get Ranked Players Leaderboard Players Get

delete.description: Deletes the signed-in account; its moves in other people's matches stay, unnamed.

get.description:
The match's events after a snapshot's event_id; a reconnect resumes from its
Last-Event-ID.

BoardSummary.title: BoardSummary
BoardSummary.description: One card on the standings index: the game, who leads it, how many are ranked.

Gates.title: Gates
Gates.description: Pass/fail checks on whether the move legitimately played the game.

GuessOpened.title: GuessOpened
GuessOpened.description:
Showcase only: every answer is judged and the guessers may call the real entry. Each
guesser reads its own options from the snapshot.

GuessOption.title: GuessOption
GuessOption.description: One entry on the table during a call. The key says nothing about which is real.

GuessRules.title: GuessRules
GuessRules.description: The call after both bluffs are judged: pick the real entry from among the bluffs.

GuessView.title: GuessView
GuessView.description: A call made: who picked, what they picked (the truth or a player's bluff), who got paid.

HostPayload.title: HostPayload
HostPayload.description: Layer 3. Badges are injected by code, never authored by the model.

Labels.title: Labels
Labels.description: Presentation strings for the slots the frontend fills per game.

MatchStarted.title: MatchStarted
MatchStarted.description: Every seat is filled and play begins.

NumPlayers.title: NumPlayers
NumPlayers.description: How many seats a table of this game may have.

OpenDuel.title: OpenDuel
OpenDuel.description: A duel the session (or its account) can walk back into.

ProfileView.title: ProfileView
ProfileView.description: A player's public programme. Open, private and closed duels appear only to the owner.

RoundRevealed.title: RoundRevealed
RoundRevealed.description: Showcase only: every call is in, so the card's truth may be shown.

RoundView.title: RoundView
RoundView.description:
A dealt card. Options are on the table while the round is being called; the truth
and the calls are filled in once the round is revealed.

ScoringPayload.title: ScoringPayload
ScoringPayload.description: Layer 2. Score keys must equal the template's rubric names.

SeatJoined.title: SeatJoined
SeatJoined.description: A player took a seat at a table that is still filling.

SeatSubmitted.title: SeatSubmitted
SeatSubmitted.description: Showcase: a seat has written or called for the round in play. Says nothing about what.

SeatView.title: SeatView
SeatView.description: One seat at the table, in turn order. Points leave out the round still being played.

SsePayloads.title: SsePayloads
SsePayloads.description: Exported so the generated TypeScript client carries every event payload type.

StageView.title: StageView
StageView.description: Public matches in play, and how many duels have finished.

TableView.title: TableView
TableView.description: An open table in the lobby, waiting for players.

TurnChanged.title: TurnChanged
TurnChanged.description: The turn passed without a ruling to show: a forfeit, a resign, or play moved on.

TurnNudge.title: TurnNudge
TurnNudge.description: Your seat is to move in a match you are not looking at.

WsPayloads.title: WsPayloads
WsPayloads.description: Exported so the generated TypeScript client carries every socket message type.
